selection.summary: Terminal review: pretty-print for DOM with documentation. The relevant surface is include/simdjson/dom/serialization.h (internal::string_builder<pretty>, print_pretty, to_string/minify overloads, simdjson_result variants) covered by h13/h14/h18 and its implementation in serialization-inl.h (h1), with public API surface on element (h2, element-inl.h h9) and user-facing documentation in doc/dom.md (h3). Evidence confirms indentation is currently fixed at four spaces in the pretty printer; the change adds configurable indentation to string_builder<pretty> with documentation. No repair/tool operations were performed or claimed; selection limited to listed delivered handles directly relevant to the pretty-print code and docs.
